timeline: Late 20th century: Spread to North America

setup.deck: 40 cards: A(1) through 10 in each suit
setup.dealing: Split deck equally; each player has a face-down stack.
setup.equipment: Standard deck with face cards and jokers removed

variations.name: Four Player Game
variations.description: Deck divided equally; each player places one card face up. First three to slap the table are silent; fourth selects one. Selected player gives solution; if correct the fourth takes the four cards, otherwise the selected player takes them. Bluffing possible.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: No engine overrides; variant changes only player count and procedure, not deck or scoring constants.

variations.name: Card collection version
variations.description: Two, three or four players. First correct solution takes the four cards under their stack. Players who run out can still call and win cards back. With three players, winner of previous set places two cards and others one each.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant describes card flow and deal pattern; no numeric or config overrides documented.

variations.name: Multi-player dealer with scoring
variations.description: Single shuffled stack; dealer drops four cards. First to find 24 scores a point. If no solution, first to call no solution scores one point; if someone then finds a solution the caller gets nothing and the finder scores two.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring variant; points replace card capture; no engine constants overridden in schema.

variations.name: Extended operations and deck
variations.description: Some allow powers and roots (e.g. 3^3=27), square root with a 2, or logarithms. Some include Jack=11, Queen=12, King=13 or Jokers 14 and 15. Factorials and approximations are not allowed; result must be exact.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule and deck extensions only; engine would need different deck type and expression evaluator.
